# Pokedex by Axl Guillen

> A Pokedex SPA built with Vue 3 as a technical interview project for Urvenue. Displays all 1025 Pokemon from the PokeAPI with search, filtering, sorting, and detailed views.

## Summary

This is a clone/recreation of the official Pokedex, built during a job interview challenge. The goal was to demonstrate frontend skills using Vue 3, Pinia, Vue Router, and Axios against a public REST API.

## Live Site

https://axlguillen.github.io/pokedex/

## Source Code

https://github.com/AxlGuillen/pokedex

## Tech Stack

- Vue 3 (Composition API)
- Pinia (state management)
- Vue Router (client-side routing, base: /pokedex)
- Axios (HTTP client)
- Vite (bundler)
- PokeAPI (https://pokeapi.co/) — public REST API, no auth required

## Routes

- `/` — Home: full Pokemon list (1025 Pokemon), search, filter by type, sort
- `/pokedex/details/:id` — Detail view for a single Pokemon

## Features

- Browse all 1025 Pokemon with paginated/load-more display
- Search by name or ID
- Filter by Pokemon type (fire, water, grass, etc.)
- Sort by ID (asc/desc) or name (A-Z / Z-A)
- Shuffle/randomize the list
- Detail page: stats, height, weight, abilities, weaknesses, descriptions, evolution chain
- Navigate to previous/next Pokemon from the detail page
- Fully responsive (mobile to 4K)

## Data Flow

1. On home load, fetches all 1025 Pokemon from PokeAPI in parallel
2. Pokemon list is stored in Pinia (`pokemonStore`)
3. Detail page fetches: pokemon data + species + evolution chain + adjacent Pokemon
4. Weaknesses are derived from type damage relations

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── views/
│   ├── homeView.vue         # List page
│   └── pokemonDetails.vue   # Detail page
├── components/
│   ├── header.vue
│   ├── pokemonsSection.vue  # Grid of cards + load more
│   ├── card.vue             # Single Pokemon card
│   ├── filters.vue          # Sort controls
│   ├── categories.vue       # Type filter chips
│   ├── categories-bigVersion.vue
│   ├── SpinnerComponent.vue
│   └── details/             # Sub-components for detail page
├── stores/
│   └── pokemonStore.js      # All API calls and state
├── router/
│   └── index.js
└── main.js
```
